title: How do I install Office 365 on my iPad or iPhone?
description: Ready to move seamlessly between your devices? We'll help you install Office 365 on your iPad or iPhone. Let's get started!   For more help, visit https://support.office.com/

asr.full_text: Office 365 Hey this is Ryan from Office, and today we're going to help you get started using Office 365 on your iPad or iPhone. First, go to the App Store and search for Office. In this example, we'll install Word, but you'll follow the same steps for every app. When the installation is done, open the app or find it on your home screen. To get started using Office, touch Sign-In with Office 365. You should sign in with the same logging you used when you activated your Office 365 subscription. If you haven't activated your subscription yet you'll need to do that. If you need help watch my video. I'll put that in the link below. Once you're signed in you can choose to turn on notifications or skip them for now. And you're all set. You can create and edit documents and use all the features of Office 365 on your iPad or iPhone. Have other questions about Microsoft Office? Check out the other Office Help videos. We're here to help you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides step-by-step guidance for finding and installing Office applications on an iPad or iPhone. It describes ordinary sign-in and setup using an account linked to an activated Office 365 subscription, and the external support link is presented as a help resource whose behavior is not assessed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational walkthrough of finding an Office app, installing it and signing in on a mobile device.
